text: No, there was no confirmed tree-cover loss on this property in 2026. The latest available data (as of November 12, 2026) only confirms a potential 13.5-hectare loss in 2025, but this requires further corroboration. The 2025 loss is still pending verification, and no later observations (e.g., for 2026) are available yet. The evidence does not establish whether the 2025 change was permanent, its cause, or if it even qualifies as deforestation. Until additional data is analyzed, we cannot confirm any tree-cover loss in 2026.
